faqMatchers.answer: Emran is an expert in real-time WebGL and Three.js 3D development! His flagship project 'Next Label' renders 409,600 simultaneous GPU particles with custom bloom post-processing shaders and sub-50ms edge streaming. You can experience it live right now at https://next-label-portfolio.pages.dev.

Emran specializes in building production autonomous AI agent systems. He engineered 'AI-Agents-Hub'—a 24/7 multi-cloud gateway running on Render and Vercel that orchestrates Hermes, OpenClaw, and Strix agents with 248+ engineering skills and bidirectional Discord/Telegram gateways.

Emran designed an end-to-end programmatic video pipeline using TypeScript, Playwright, neural Edge-TTS, and FFmpeg 2-Pass rendering that generates 1080x1920 60FPS vertical reels completely autonomously without manual editing. Check out his Media Gallery on the portfolio!

Emran is available for select freelance contracts, technical advisory, and full-stack software development engagements. You can submit an inquiry directly via the Contact page or email him, and he guarantees a personal response within 2 hours. Would you like to leave a quick message or email address for him?

Emran's core production stack includes Node.js 22, TypeScript, Next.js 15, Three.js & GLSL Shaders, PostgreSQL & Drizzle ORM, Docker containerization, Cloudflare Pages Edge, and Multi-Agent AI Frameworks (NVIDIA NIM, Google Antigravity SDK).

Emran Hosen is a Software Developer and AI Agent Architect based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, working with global clients. He specializes in full-stack cloud systems, autonomous agent workflows, and award-grade WebGL 3D web applications.
